typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		LetterDate as string,
		Provider_ID as string,
		Provider_TIN as string,
		Provider_NPI as string,
		Provider_Name as string,
		Address_Line1 as string,
		Address_Line2 as string,
		CITY as string,
		STATE as string,
		ZIP as string,
		Phone as string,
		Member_Subscriber_ID as string,
		Member_Name as string,
		Member_Claim_Number as string,
		Member_DOB as string,
		Member_Admit_Date as string,
		Member_Discharge_Date as string,
		Total_Charges as string,
		Paid_Amount as string,
		Admit_Src as string,
		Letter_Brand as string,
		Letter_Logo as string,
		Letter_Tag_Line as string,
		Original_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes as string,
		Revised_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes as string,
		Original_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes as string,
		Revised_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes as string,
		Original_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes as string,
		Revised_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes as string,
		Original_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes as string,
		Revised_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes as string,
		Org_Discharge_Status as string,
		Revised_Discharge_Status as string,
		Org_DRG_Assigned as string,
		Revised_DRG_Assigned as string,
		Audit_Rationale as string,
		Evidence_from_Medical_Record as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select  	LetterDate = Format(GetDate(),\'yyyy-MM-dd\') 	,Provider_ID = \'\' 	,Provider_TIN = COALESCE(TIN,\'\') 	,Provider_NPI = COALESCE(dv.NPI,\'\') 	,Provider_Name = COALESCE(REPLACE(ProviderFacilityName,\' – \',\' - \'),\'\') 	,Address_Line1 = COALESCE(Address1,\'\') 	,Address_Line2 = COALESCE(Address2,\'\') 	,CITY = COALESCE(City,\'\') 	,STATE = COALESCE(State,\'\') 	,ZIP = COALESCE(ZipCode,\'\') 	,Phone = COALESCE(LTD.Phone,\'\') 	,Member_Subscriber_ID = COALESCE(SubscriberId,\'\') 	,Member_Name = COALESCE(MemberName,\'\') 	,Member_Claim_Number = CAST(COALESCE(ClaimNumber,\'\') as NVARCHAR(20)) 	,Member_DOB = COALESCE(MemberBirthDate,\'\') 	,Member_Admit_Date = COALESCE(Format(DateOfServiceStartDate,\'yyyy-MM-dd\'),\'\') 	,Member_Discharge_Date = COALESCE(Format(DateOfServiceEndDate, \'yyyy-MM-dd\'),\'\') 	,Total_Charges = COALESCE(Format(ClaimTotalCharge,\'0.00\'),\'\') 	,Paid_Amount = COALESCE(Format(PaidAmount, \'0.00\'),\'\') 	,Admit_Src = SUBSTRING(COALESCE(admissionTypeCode,\'\'),1,PATINDEX(\'%[^0-9]%\', COALESCE(admissionTypeCode,\' \'))-1)	,Letter_Brand = COALESCE(DRG.LETTER_BRAND,\'\') 	,Letter_Logo = COALESCE(DRG.LOGO,\'\') 	,Letter_Tag_Line = COALESCE(DRG.TAG_LINE,\'\')     ,Original_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(PrincipalDiagnosisCode_Orig,\'\')     ,Revised_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(PrincipalDiagnosisCode_Revised,\'\')     ,Original_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(SecondaryDiagnosisCodes_Orig,\'\')     ,Revised_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(SecondaryDiagnosisCodes_Revised,\'\')     ,Original_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(PrincipalProcedureCode_Orig,\'\')     ,Revised_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(PrincipalProcedureCode_Revised,\'\')     ,Original_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(SecondaryProcedureCodes_Orig,\'\')     ,Revised_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(SecondaryProcedureCodes_Revised,\'\')     ,Org_Discharge_Status = COALESCE(DischargeStatusCode_Orig,\'\')     ,Revised_Discharge_Status = COALESCE(DischargeStatusCode_Revised,\'\')     ,Org_DRG_Assigned = COALESCE(DrgCode_Orig,\'\')     ,Revised_DRG_Assigned = COALESCE(DrgCode_Revised,\'\')     ,Audit_Rationale = COALESCE(RationaleDescription,\'\')     ,Evidence_from_Medical_Record = \'\' From [TRK].[Report].[vwCSBDDrgValidationCAPAReceived] dv Left Join [EPA].[EPA_CLAIM_DRG_VALIDATION] DRG ON dv.ClaimNumber = DRG.CLM_NBR Left Join EPA.CSBD.LetterAuditType AD ON AD.Audit_Name = \'DRG Validation\' Left Join EPA.CSBD.LetterAddress LTD ON LTD.Audit_ID = AD.Audit_ID Left Join EPA.[EPA_DRG-V_XML_Letter_Gen_Log] log On ClaimNumber = log.ClaimID Where dv.[Provider_Addess_Active_Flag] = 1 And ((log.ClaimID IS Null ) OR (log.Resend = 1))  UNION   Select  LetterDate = Format(GetDate(),\'yyyy-MM-dd\') ,Provider_ID = COALESCE(CSBDF.Provider_ID,\'\') ,Provider_TIN = COALESCE(CSBDF.Provider_TIN,\'\') ,Provider_NPI = COALESCE(CSBDF.Provider_NPI,\'\') ,Provider_Name = COALESCE(CSBDF.Provider_Name,\'\') ,Address_Line1 = COALESCE(PV.Address1,\'\') ,Address_Line2 = COALESCE(PV.Address2,\'\') ,CITY = COALESCE(PV.CITY,\'\') ,STATE = COALESCE(PV.STATE,\'\') ,ZIP = COALESCE(PV.ZIP_CODE,\'\') ,Phone = COALESCE(LTD.Phone,\'\') ,Member_Subscriber_ID = COALESCE(CSBDF.Member_Subscriber_ID,\'\') ,Member_Name = COALESCE(CSBDF.Member_Name,\'\') ,Member_Claim_Number = CAST(COALESCE(CSBDF.Member_Claim_Number,\'\') as NVARCHAR(20)) ,Member_DOB = COALESCE(FORMAT(CSBDF.Member_DOB,\'yyyy-MM-dd\'),\'\') ,Member_Admit_Date = COALESCE(FORMAT(CSBDF.Member_Admit_Date,\'yyyy-MM-dd\'),\'\') ,Member_Discharge_Date = COALESCE(Format(CSBDF.Member_Discharge_Date, \'yyyy-MM-dd\'),\'\') ,Total_Charges = COALESCE(CSBDF.Total_Charges,\'\') ,Paid_Amount = COALESCE(CSBDF.Paid_Amount,\'\') ,Admit_Src = SUBSTRING(COALESCE(CSBDF.Admit_Src,\'\'),1,PATINDEX(\'%[^0-9]%\', COALESCE(CSBDF.Admit_Src,\' \'))-1),Letter_Brand = COALESCE(DRG.LETTER_BRAND,\'\')  ,Letter_Logo = COALESCE(DRG.LOGO,\'\')  ,Letter_Tag_Line = COALESCE(DRG.TAG_LINE,\'\')  ,Original_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Original_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes,\'\') ,Revised_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes,\'\') ,Original_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Original_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes,\'\') ,Revised_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes,\'\') ,Original_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Original_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes,\'\') ,Revised_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes,\'\') ,Original_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Original_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes,\'\') ,Revised_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes,\'\') ,Org_Discharge_Status = COALESCE(CSBDF.Org_Discharge_Status,\'\') ,Revised_Discharge_Status = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_Discharge_Status,\'\') ,Org_DRG_Assigned = COALESCE(CSBDF.Org_DRG_Assigned ,\'\') ,Revised_DRG_Assigned = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_DRG_Assigned,\'\') ,Audit_Rationale = COALESCE(CSBDF.Audit_Rationale,\'\') ,Evidence_from_Medical_Record = \'\' From TRK.[Case].[vwCsbdDrgFindingLetter] CSBDF Inner Join EPA.PROVIDER_ADDRESS_LOAD PV on PV.TAX_ID = CSBDF.Provider_TIN  Left Join [EPA].[EPA_CLAIM_DRG_VALIDATION] DRG ON CSBDF.Member_Claim_Number = DRG.CLM_NBR Left Join EPA.CSBD.LetterAuditType AD ON AD.Audit_Name = \'DRG Validation\' Left Join EPA.CSBD.LetterAddress LTD ON LTD.Audit_ID = AD.Audit_ID Left Join EPA.[EPA_DRG-V_XML_Letter_Gen_Log] log On CSBDF.Member_Claim_Number = log.ClaimID Where  1=1 And PV.ACTIVE = 1 And ((log.ClaimID IS Null ) OR (log.Resend = 1)) And PV.NPI = CSBDF.Provider_NPI',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> Pulldatafromdatabase
Pulldatafromdatabase split(Provider_TIN == '' || Provider_NPI == '' || Provider_Name == '' || Address_Line1 == '' || CITY == '' || STATE == '' || ZIP == '' || Phone == '' || Member_Subscriber_ID == '' || Member_Name == '' || Member_Claim_Number == '' || Member_DOB == '' || Member_Admit_Date == '' || Member_Discharge_Date == '' || Total_Charges == '' || Paid_Amount == '' || Admit_Src == '' || Letter_Brand == '' || Letter_Logo == '' || Letter_Tag_Line == '' || Original_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes == '' || Revised_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes == '' || Org_Discharge_Status == '' || Revised_Discharge_Status == '' || Org_DRG_Assigned == '' || Revised_DRG_Assigned == '' || Audit_Rationale == '', disjoint: true) ~> Filterrecordswithmissingdata@(MissingRequiredData,GoodData)
Filterrecordswithmissingdata@MissingRequiredData sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		{})) ~> OutputPlaceHolderMissingRequiredData
Filterrecordswithmissingdata@GoodData sink(input(
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn()) ~> OutputPlaceHolderGoodData
